Container.Name: Enphase Envoy MQTT
Container.Overview: Unraid packaging and configuration layer for vk2him/Enphase-Envoy-mqtt-json. Reads real-time data from an Enphase Envoy Gateway and publishes it to an MQTT broker. Includes optional Victron Cerbo GX / Venus OS integration examples.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Persistent configuration and Enphase authentication token.

Config.Name: MQTT Broker Host
Config.Description: Hostname or IP address of the MQTT broker. For Victron Cerbo GX, enter the Cerbo GX IP address.

Config.Name: MQTT Username
Config.Description: MQTT username. Leave empty if authentication is not required.

Config.Name: MQTT Password
Config.Description: MQTT password. Leave empty if authentication is not required.

Config.Name: MQTT Topic
Config.Description: MQTT topic where the Envoy JSON data will be published.

Config.Name: Envoy Host
Config.Description: Hostname or IP address of the Enphase Envoy Gateway.

Config.Name: Enphase Account Email
Config.Description: Enphase Enlighten account email. Required for modern D7/D8 firmware authentication.

Config.Name: Enphase Account Password
Config.Description: Enphase Enlighten account password. Used to obtain or renew the local Envoy authentication token.

Config.Name: Use HTTPS
Config.Description: Use HTTPS when connecting to the Envoy. Recommended for recent firmware.

Config.Name: Enphase Battery Installed
Config.Description: Enable if the Enphase installation includes an Enphase battery.

Config.Name: Debug
Config.Description: Enable verbose debugging from the upstream application.
